answer: Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
